lines.trans: I will never take a woman into the kitchen.
What foolish thoughts, Viktor?
Women talk too much at work.
In my kitchen there is always perfect order.
In a restaurant kitchen strict control is needed.
My cooks work calmly and neatly.
You will not cope with our hard work.
I cope with any difficult task.
At Claude Monet restaurant it is very hard.
I am not afraid of hard work, chef!
You do not understand our male rules.
The rules in the kitchen are the same for everyone.
Then prove it in deed, Elena!

examples.trans: They have to be washed carefully by hand.
Put the glasses carefully on the table.
We have nobody to fear here.
I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.note: 'взять на работу' = to give someone a job
polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.note: много дел = a lot to do

examples.trans: I have a lot to do.
We could open a salon for you.

meanings.note: что и требовалось доказать = Q.E.D., which is what needed to be proved

examples.trans: There, which is what needed to be proved!
I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Мы создадим идеальную команду для работы.
examples.trans: We will create an ideal team for work.

examples.text: Сегодня стояла идеальная погода для прогулки.
examples.trans: Today there was ideal weather for a walk.
Three rooms and a big kitchen.

meanings.note: в любой момент = at any moment

examples.trans: An interesting thought occurred to him.
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
used with не before the verb, or alone

examples.text: Я никогда не был на море.
examples.trans: I've never been to the sea.

meanings.note: short form 'нужен / нужна / нужно / нужны' + dative: 'мне нужна работа' = I need a job

examples.trans: I love our town very much.

meanings.note: понимаешь? = you know? do you understand?

examples.trans: I want to go to the sea, you know?

meanings.note: по порядку = in order; всё в порядке = everything is fine

examples.trans: Now let's go through everything in order.

meanings.note: работать + instrumental = to work as: работать мэром

examples.text: Слушай, Нина, это же тот самый ресторан!
examples.trans: Listen, Nina, this is that very restaurant!

examples.text: Мы рады видеть вас в нашем ресторане.
examples.trans: We are glad to see you in our restaurant.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

справиться.gloss: to manage, to cope, to handle

meanings.note: often + с + instrumental, or used absolutely

examples.text: Мы за два года тут не справимся.
examples.trans: We won't manage here in two years.

meanings.en: to cope with, manage, handle (+ с + instrumental or absolutely)

examples.text: Ты отлично справляешься сегодня на смене.
examples.trans: You are doing great on the shift today.
How strict you are, Klavdia Viktorovna.

examples.text: У нас в школе очень строгий директор.
examples.trans: We have a very strict principal at our school.

meanings.note: + dative: мне тяжело = it's hard for me

examples.trans: It's hard for you right now.

meanings.note: in weight, or тяжёлый металл = heavy metal

examples.text: Я вообще в школе тяжёлый металл любила!
examples.trans: In school I actually loved heavy metal!

meanings.note: points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом
other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
